tools.name: wisdom_search
tools.description: Search 227 English / 227 Korean curated wisdom documents (9 pillars: dharmic, Abrahamic, East Asian, Hellenic, indigenous, mystical, modern philosophy, science, integral). Returns titles, short snippets and source links. / WIA Wisdom 문서를 키워드로 검색한다(영/한).

tools.name: wisdom_get_doc
tools.description: Fetch one document by its path (from wisdom_search). By default returns an excerpt (first ~1,500 characters) with source links; full text is returned only if the server owner has enabled it. / 문서 경로로 발췌와 출처 링크를 가져온다.

tools.name: wisdom_list_pillars
tools.description: List the 9 pillars with document counts per language and example topics. / 9개 기둥과 언어별 문서 수.
